**ABSOLUTELY READ-ONLY.** Do NOT edit, stage, commit, stash, checkout, or modify anything. Two other agent sessions are writing to this working tree. Use ONLY: `git show`, `git diff`, `git log`, `grep`, `cat`/`sed -n`. Verify file CONTENT via `git show HEAD:<path>` NOT the working tree. Compute line numbers via `git show HEAD:<path> | cat -n`.

Verify these claims. Report CORRECT / WRONG (with what's actually true) / STALE / OVERSTATED / UNVERIFIABLE.

## Part 2 assessment claims

1. "Tier classification now lives in **four** places":
   - `protectedFiles.md:19` says UiCopyProvider is Tier 2 — verify line 19.
   - `CODEOWNERS:93` says Tier 2 — verify line 93.
   - "`generateRegistry.mjs:140` `TIER2_PATHS` **not updated** — hardcoded mirror" — find the real file path (probably `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs`), verify line 140 has TIER2_PATHS, verify it does NOT include uiCopyProvider, and verify it's a hardcoded array not a parse of the rules files.
   - "`.claude/registry/components.md` says **'4 — Feature-local'**" for uiCopyProvider — verify the file exists and what it actually says for uiCopyProvider.
   - "It needs `'app/components/uiCopyProvider/'` added to that array." — verify the array's entry format matches that string shape (i.e. does it use `app/components/...` prefixes?).
2. "**`syncCursorRules.mjs`'s manifest omits `components.md`, `css.md` and `overrideStyling.md` entirely.** So the `var(--zimm-*)` mandate and the hook exception ... **reach Claude Code only.** Anyone using Cursor or Copilot on this codebase is working from the pre-inversion rules." — find `scripts/syncCursorRules.mjs`, read its manifest, and verify precisely which rules files it includes/omits. Is the claim accurate? Note: `.github/copilot-instructions.md` WAS regenerated in this range — check whether it actually contains the var(--zimm-*) mandate (which would contradict the "reach Claude Code only" claim).
3. "**`seedRegions.mjs` carries a static copy** of the site list from `contentfulMapping.generated.ts`, with a comment acknowledging it can drift." — verify.
4. "**`useZimmModal` now has 5 consumers**, which meets `protectedFiles.md`'s own stated 'Shared Hooks — 5+ consumers' threshold for Tier 2. It wasn't added to the list or to CODEOWNERS." — COUNT the real consumers (files importing useZimmModal) at HEAD. Is it 5? Be precise about whether tests/stories count. Verify it's absent from protectedFiles.md and CODEOWNERS.
5. "`overrideStyling.md:188` still cites `button.ts` as the example of a value that *"stays behind the full gate"* — the exact file `a063e14` moved out from behind it, **24 minutes after that sentence was written**." — verify line 188 quote, and compute the ACTUAL time gap between the commit that wrote that sentence (find which commit added overrideStyling.md:188 — use `git log -S` or `git blame`) and `a063e14`'s commit timestamp. Report the real gap in minutes. Use `git log --format='%H %ad' --date=iso`.
6. "`zimmButton.css.ts:243` exports `Button` — the recipe key that styles **every Chakra `<Button>` in the app** — carrying `BTN_HEIGHT_LG = '50px'`, `BTN_HEIGHT_SM = '41px'`, `BTN_PADDING_Y = '5px'` at `:205-207`." — verify the file path (`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts`?), line 243, and lines 205-207 with those exact constants and values.
7. "`uiCopy` — hand-rolled raw `fetch` with the token in the **query string**, mounted app-wide at `_app-config/index.tsx:161`, so it fires on **every page of every storefront**, uncached, with **no `limit`**. Contentful's CDA defaults to `limit=100`. **At the 101st `uiCopy` entry, entries silently drop out**". Verify:
   - `overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts` — is the uiCopy fetch a raw `fetch` with `access_token` in the query string? Report the actual URL construction code.
   - Is there really no `limit` parameter?
   - `overrides/app/components/_app-config/index.tsx:161` — is `<UiCopyProvider>` there at line 161?
   - Does the hand-rolled fetch have any caching (module-level cache, useMemo, etc.)? Verify "uncached" precisely.
8. "`overrides/app/hooks/useContentful.ts:88-156` is a hand-rolled `useState` + `useEffect` + `fetch`. There is no cache, no dedup, no query key." — verify the line range and the claim.
9. "the `.catch` in `footer/index.tsx:193` swallows the error with **no logging and no telemetry.**" — verify line 193 and the catch body.
10. "This is a project with an LCP budget of ≤2s at p75 mobile, and this adds two uncached CDA round-trips to every page." — verify the LCP budget claim against AGENTS.md/.docs. Also: does the footerConfig fetch really fire on every page (is Footer rendered app-wide)? And does uiCopy fire on every page?
11. "`testing.md`'s new own-test-file rule cites `zimmSubscribeSection/index.test.tsx` as its reference implementation — added in the same branch." — verify testing.md at HEAD cites that exact file.
12. "`components.md`'s container/presentational exception names `useUiCopy`" — verify.
13. "the last review on PR #59 predates all 14 commits and now reads `DISMISSED`" — SKIP, another agent covers this.
14. "**`overrideStyling.md` now contradicts itself** ... Line 16 says *"**Never** a bare Chakra/theme token string."* 120 lines later, in a section with **zero hunks touched** in this range, `:137-140` still says: > reference it **by name** in the theme config (`marginBottom: 'xs'`, not `marginBottom: 2` or `marginBottom: '0.5rem'`)" — verify line 16, verify :137-140 quote, verify that section really has zero hunks touched in the range (`git diff ec9d161 7b9b5dc -- .claude/rules/overrideStyling.md` and check hunk line ranges), and verify "120 lines later" arithmetic.
15. "The same section also cites `theme/components/imageGallery.ts` and `swatchGroup.ts` as its exemplars — neither file exists, and neither existed before this range either." — verify both at HEAD and at ec9d161. Search the whole repo for those filenames.
16. "**The `audit:tokens` allow-list has no word boundaries.** The marker regex is `/provisional|pending|placeholder|audit-allow/i`, so a comment reading *"depending on the viewport"* matches `pending`" — verify the regex byte-for-byte in scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs and that it has no `\b`.
17. "`466e62b`'s own remedy for `zimmButton.css.ts` was to **reword a comment** — adding 'PROVISIONAL' and 'pending sign-off' — while `'50px'`/`'41px'`/`'5px'` stayed exactly as they were." — verify with `git show 466e62b -- <zimmButton.css.ts path>`.
18. "**`.docs/memory/projectState.md` is stale**: Its `Last updated:` stamp still reads 2026-08-18, it still asserts *"`button.ts` established as the single source of truth for button styling"*, it still describes *"per-component overrides in `overrides/app/theme/components/`"* with no mention of co-location, and **the footer / SFCC-55 work does not appear anywhere** in 'What's Complete' or 'In Progress.' `sprintScope.md` wasn't touched at all." — verify EVERY part, including the exact date stamp and the exact quoted strings. Note: the doc earlier says "Four `.docs/` files" were changed in the range — check whether projectState.md was one of them.
19. "**`uiCopyProvider/` has no `.stories.tsx`**" — verify by listing the directory at HEAD.
20. "**`en-CA` is never created in Contentful.** `bootstrapSpace.mjs` creates 9 locales; `SUPPORTED_LOCALES` has 10. The missing one is `en-CA` ... while `seedRegions.mjs` creates `region-ZimmermannUSIntl` with `locale: 'en-CA'`." — verify: find bootstrapSpace.mjs, COUNT the locales it creates, find SUPPORTED_LOCALES and COUNT it, verify the missing one is en-CA, and verify seedRegions.mjs's region-ZimmermannUSIntl entry.
21. "`pages/experience/index.tsx:54` notes *"A real 404 needs SSR prefetch (getProps) — tracked separately."*" — verify path, line, quote.
22. "there is no `getProps` anywhere in the footer path" — verify by grepping the footer component tree.
23. "Every footer link left the initial HTML — including the entire legal set" and the list "Privacy Policy, Terms, Accessibility, Modern Slavery and Cookie Settings" — where does that list come from? Is it from the story fixture (`footer/index.stories.content.ts`) or from real Contentful data? If it's only in the fixture, the claim that a Contentful blip "blanks Privacy Policy, Terms, Accessibility, Modern Slavery and Cookie Settings" is inferential, not verified. Report.
24. "The strongest mechanical gate in the repo now sits on the one rule its own documentation describes as not being about correctness." + the §3 "Enforcement is inverted" table rows: "`npm run lint` | red today, 19 errors | ❌ **nothing**" — SKIP the lint counts (another agent covers). But verify: is the recipeGuards suite really run by `npm run test`?

Report terse findings organised as WRONG / STALE / OVERSTATED / UNVERIFIABLE / CORRECT with exact real values.

   212	/**

   228	/**
   229	 * Strip existing frontmatter (content between the first pair of --- lines) from a markdown string.
   230	 * Returns the body content without frontmatter.
   231	 */
   232	function stripFrontmatter(content) {
   233	    const lines = content.split('\n')
   234	    if (lines[0].trim() !== '---') {
   235	        return content
   236	    }
   237	    const closingIndex = lines.findIndex((line, i) => i > 0 && line.trim() === '---')
   238	    if (closingIndex === -1) {
   239	        return content
   240	    }
   241	    return lines.slice(closingIndex + 1).join('\n').trimStart()
   242	}
   243	
   244	/**
   245	 * Extract a single field value from a markdown file's YAML frontmatter.
   246	 * Returns null if no frontmatter exists or the field is not present.
   247	 */
   248	function extractFrontmatterField(content, field) {
   249	    const lines = content.split('\n')
   250	    if (lines[0].trim() !== '---') return null
   251	    const closingIndex = lines.findIndex((line, i) => i > 0 && line.trim() === '---')
   252	    if (closingIndex === -1) return null
   253	    const fmLines = lines.slice(1, closingIndex)
   254	    const match = fmLines
   255	        .map((line) => line.match(new RegExp(`^${field}:\\s*(.*)$`)))
   256	        .find((m) => m !== null)
   257	    return match ? match[1].trim() : null
   258	}

   260	/**
   261	 * Get the mtime (modification time) of a file in milliseconds.
   262	 * Returns 0 if the file does not exist.
   263	 */
   264	function getMtime(filePath) {
   265	    try {
   266	        return fs.statSync(filePath).mtimeMs
   267	    } catch {
   268	        return 0

   272	/**

   275	function formatTimeDiff(ms) {
   276	    const seconds = Math.round(ms / 1000)
   277	    const minutes = Math.round(seconds / 60)
   278	    const hours = Math.round(minutes / 60)
   279	    const days = Math.round(hours / 24)
   280	    if (days > 0) return `${days} day${days === 1 ? '' : 's'} newer`
   281	    if (hours > 0) return `${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? '' : 's'} newer`
   282	    if (minutes > 0) return `${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? '' : 's'} newer`
   283	    return `${seconds} second${seconds === 1 ? '' : 's'} newer`

   402	/**
   403	 * Regenerate a target file from its source(s). Dispatches on entry.mode:
   404	 *   - 'rule':    single source, full Cursor frontmatter from manifest
   405	 *   - 'skill':   single source, description extracted from source frontmatter
   406	 *   - 'compile': multi-source concatenation, plain markdown (no Cursor frontmatter)
   407	 */
   408	function regenerateTarget(entry) {
   409	    const sources = Array.isArray(entry.source) ? entry.source : [entry.source]
   410	    const targetPath = path.join(ROOT, entry.target)
   411	    const syncList = sources.join(', ')
   412	    const syncedFromComment = `<!-- synced-from: ${syncList} — edit the source(s), not this file, then run: node scripts/syncCursorRules.mjs --fix -->`
   413	
   414	    let output
   415	
   416	    if (entry.mode === 'rule') {
   417	        const body = stripFrontmatter(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, sources[0]), 'utf8'))
   418	        const frontmatter = buildFrontmatter(entry.frontmatter)
   419	        output = `${frontmatter}\n${syncedFromComment}\n\n${body}`
   420	    } else if (entry.mode === 'skill') {
   421	        const sourceContent = fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, sources[0]), 'utf8')
   422	        const description = extractFrontmatterField(sourceContent, 'description')

   425	        }
   426	        const body = stripFrontmatter(sourceContent)
   427	        const frontmatter = buildFrontmatter({
   428	            description,
   429	            globs: entry.frontmatter?.globs ?? '',
   430	            alwaysApply: entry.frontmatter?.alwaysApply ?? false
   431	        })
   432	        output = `${frontmatter}\n${syncedFromComment}\n\n${body}`
   433	    } else if (entry.mode === 'compile') {
   434	        const parts = sources.map((s) => {
   435	            const body = stripFrontmatter(fs.readFileSync(path.join(ROOT, s), 'utf8')).trim()
   436	            return `<!-- from: ${s} -->\n\n${body}`
   437	        })
   438	        const title = entry.title ? `# ${entry.title}\n\n` : ''
   439	        output = `${syncedFromComment}\n\n${title}${parts.join('\n\n---\n\n')}\n`
   440	    } else {
   441	        throw new Error(`Unknown mode '${entry.mode}' for target ${entry.target}`)
   442	    }
   443	
   444	    const targetDir = path.dirname(targetPath)
   445	    if (!fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
   446	        fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, {recursive: true})
   447	    }
   448	    fs.writeFileSync(targetPath, output, 'utf8')
   449	}
